title: CloudFront
explanation: Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network (CDN) that delivers data, videos, applications, and APIs globally with low latency and high transfer speeds. It caches content at edge locations worldwide.
analogy: CloudFront is like a chain of local libraries — instead of everyone traveling to the main library (origin), copies of popular books (content) are distributed to branches (edge locations) closer to readers.
keyPoints: Over 400 edge locations and 13 regional edge caches worldwide
Supports custom SSL certificates and HTTPS enforcement
Origin Access Control (OAC) restricts S3 access to CloudFront only
Lambda@Edge and CloudFront Functions enable edge compute

examKeywords.definition: AWS CDN service that caches and delivers content from edge locations worldwide, reducing latency for global users.

commonMistakes: Not invalidating cache after content updates — stale content persists until TTL expires
Using CloudFront for dynamic content without understanding cache behaviors
